findings.title: Round 7's archive fix does not work: `--no-renames` exposes the archive move's SOURCE paths, so every archive PR still derives a real change id - and so does every PR whose base predates an archive commit
findings.one_line: Excluding the destination (`archive/`) while mandating `--no-renames` is self-defeating: `--no-renames` is exactly what puts the move's source paths `openspec/changes/<id>/...` into the diff. Verified on three real archive commits - none derives an empty set - and on this change's own branch, which derives 2 ids at base=main~1 and would hard-red as ambiguous.
demonstrated_by: derive 247bc201^ 247bc201 -> derive-descriptors-from-contracts (1 id, blocking run against a dir that no longer exists on the branch: git ls-tree -r 247bc201 openspec/changes/derive-descriptors-from-contracts/ -> 0)
derive 600744a5^ 600744a5 -> 2 ids -> ambiguity rule -> hard red
derive origin/main~1 HEAD -> 2 ids (this change's own PR, if its base predates the archive commit)
findings.candidate_fix_demonstrated: Adding `--diff-filter=d` (exclude pure deletions) makes all three archive commits derive the empty set (-> SKIP, correct) and makes the stale-base case derive exactly `trace-requirements-to-contracts`. An exists-on-HEAD filter on derived ids is equivalent. Choose one and mirror it into spec.md, design.md:499-509, tasks.md:663-676, work-packages.yaml:434-442, and scenario archive-pull-requests-skip.
